limits.ladder-occupancy: a ladder never occupies a tile: this sets only whether the pathing sweep meets it
limits.door-state: a door's blocking also follows whether it is open or shut
limits.height-test: the cover height test still counts a door or a sturdy prop whatever this says
limits.stops-floor: it saves bCanStepUpOn off: the floor search stops at it and finds no floor there
limits.sight-floor: on a tile it is the floor of, the floor's own flag still blocks sight upward
limits.interactive: an interactive prop is never cover by the game's normal test (it saves bInteractive)
limits.gate: it saves bIgnoreForPathing: every pathing, cover and sight sweep passes it by; the occupancy step does not
limits.no-collision: it collides with nothing, so no trace meets it: the setting takes effect only if it gets collision
limits.no-body-setup: its mesh has no simple collision (BodySetup): the pathing, cover and sight sweeps pass through it
limits.destination: it saves bIsValidDestination off: a unit may not end its move on it
limits.assumed: part of it comes from an archetype in another package that could not be read: the class default is assumed
